about: How heavy is a cloud? Four things taken as given, and what follows from them. The page quotes a `said` or shows a `value` (data-src on the element), and the stage reads the same `value`s (src/worlds/sky.js), so the words and the picture cannot disagree.

side.said: a kilometre long, wide and tall

water.note: liquid water in a cubic metre of such a cloud

drop.note: a cloud drop's diameter: a radius of 10 micrometres

rise.note: the air under a fair-weather cumulus rises about a metre a second

liquid.from: 500 t of water at a tonne a cubic metre

fall.from: Stokes: 2 r2 g (1000 kg per m3) / (9 x 1.8e-5 Pa s) with r = 10 micrometres

times.from: 1 m per s / 1.2 cm per s
